body: {"/properties/coverage_end/description":"必填，数据覆盖结束日期，格式 YYYY-MM-DD","/properties/coverage_scope/description":"必填，覆盖范围说明，如 \"A股股票日线\"","/properties/coverage_start/description":"必填，数据覆盖起始日期，格式 YYYY-MM-DD","/properties/dataset_number/description":"listMyData 返回的 run 级 dataset 编号","/properties/description/description":"平台对象描述（必填，非空）","/properties/frequency/description":"必填，更新频率：daily（每日更新）或 single_period（一次性单期）","/properties/name/description":"平台对象名称","/properties/primary_key/description":"必填，逗号分隔的主键列名列表，如 \"trade_date,ts_code\"","/properties/semantic_refs/description":"必填，逗号分隔的语义定义引用列表，每项 name@version，如 \"price_daily@1,adj_factor@2\"；语义定义必须已在平台登记，否则登记失败"}
